Priya K.: Hi all — quick onboarding snag. I need to spin up an Engineering RFC from the company template but "duplicate" only lists my personal workspace. I also can't create a page under /docs -> Engineering. Who should I ask for access?
Rae (DevEx): Welcome Priya! That sounds like you only have Viewer on the Engineering space. Which email did you use to sign up?
Priya K.: priya.k+redwood@gmail.com. I can open the template page but the 'Duplicate' flow won't let me pick 'Redwood' as a destination.
Ethan M.: Yep that's the space-permission behavior. We lock org templates to prevent accidental leaks. You need Editor on the 'Engineering' space to duplicate org-level templates.
Priya K.: Is there a self-serve way, or do I have to wait for someone to invite me?
Lina: We have a short form for access requests: https://redwood.example.com/docs-access (choose 'Editor' + target space = Engineering). Takes <15m during business hours.
Priya K.: OK tried the form, it says "pending approval". Anything I can do to unblock my RFC today?
Rae (DevEx): If it's urgent, @Docs-bot can grant a temporary Editor for templates. Run: `@docs-bot grant priya.k+redwood@gmail.com editor engineering --temp 4h` in #devex and include the template URL and purpose. Docs-bot will record the change.
Priya K.: Trying it now: `@docs-bot grant priya.k+redwood@gmail.com editor engineering --temp 4h` https://notion.so/redwood/Engineering-RFC-Template
Docs-bot: Request received. Approval chain: DevEx -> Space Admin. Granting a 4h Editor token for priya.k+redwood@gmail.com on 'Engineering' if approved. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ethan M.: Approved. Docs-bot: `grant priya.k+redwood@gmail.com editor engineering temporary`
Docs-bot: Granted Editor role for priya.k+redwood@gmail.com on space 'Engineering' until +4 hours. :tada:
Priya K.: I can duplicate now. Thank you!! :raised_hands:
Rae (DevEx): Heads up for future hires — two tips: 1) Favorite the /docs > Engineering > Templates page so duplication picks the right workspace by default. 2) If you only need a draft, you can create a blank page in your personal workspace and then use the "Move to" action to relocate it into /docs once you have perms.
Priya K.: Where are naming conventions and the RFC checklist documented? I want to make sure I follow the template rules.
Lina: See /docs > Standards > Notion Naming & RFC Checklist. If you can't navigate directly, here's the short path: Docs sidebar -> Standards -> Notion Naming & RFC Checklist.
Ethan M.: Also note: some templates (security, legal, payroll) are restricted and cannot be duplicated. If you hit that, open a Docs request and state your business need and reviewer will create a copy for you.
Priya K.: Saved links and favorited Templates. All set for my RFC. Thanks everyone! :smile:
